info.title: YC Startup Jobs API: Work at a Startup Roles with Salary and Equity
info.description:
Y Combinator startup jobs with salary, equity and YC batch as JSON.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/yc-startup-jobs (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Returns Y Combinator startup jobs from Work at a Startup: title, company, YC batch, one-liner, role, employment type, location, salary range, equity range, skills, minimum experience, visa support, posting date and apply link. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

searchUrls.title: YC Jobs search URLs
searchUrls.description: Paste Y Combinator Jobs / Work at a Startup search URLs to scrape exactly.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Keyword or role to search when no search URL is supplied.

role.title: Role filter
role.description: Optional YC role slug, such as software-engineer, product-manager, sales or designer.

location.title: Location filter
location.description: Optional YC location slug or location query.

maxResults.title: Max results per search
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to return per URL or query. A request returns 20 rows at most.

201.description: The results, one object per row.

400.description: The request body does not fit the input fields. The message says which field.
